title: Agent Bain vs. Agent McKinsey: A New Text-to-SQL Benchmark for the Business Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated business recommendations (Type 4 queries) using a strategic management consulting-inspired evaluation framework. An 'Ethical Responsibility' metric (scored 0-5 by an LLM-as-a-judge) assesses whether the outputs uphold AI ethics, mitigate observed demographic biases, prevent disparate impact, and avoid perpetuating social inequalities (e.g., bias against applicants from specific zip codes).
